import Mathlib

inductive Node
| mk (val : Int) (is_end : Bool) (left mid right : Option Node)
deriving Inhabited

namespace Node

def val (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with | Node.mk v _ _ _ _ => v

def is_end (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ b _ _ _ => b

def left (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ l _ _ => l

def mid (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ _ m _ => m

def right (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ _ _ r => r

end Node

def view (t : Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  let l := match t.left with | some child => view child | none => ∅
  let r := match t.right with | some child => view child | none => ∅
  let m := match t.mid with | some child => (view child).image (fun s => t.val :: s) | none => ∅
  let current := if t.is_end then {[t.val]} else ∅
  l ∪ r ∪ m ∪ current
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry

def is_empty_node (t : Node) : Bool :=
  !t.is_end ∧ t.left.isNone ∧ t.mid.isNone ∧ t.right.isNone

def well_formed (t : Node) : Prop :=
  (0 ≤ t.val ∧ t.val < 256) ∧
  -- Check Left
  (match t.left with 
   | some l => 
       well_formed l ∧ 
       !is_empty_node l ∧ -- CRITICAL: Match Dafny pruning
       (∀ s ∈ view l, match s with | [] => False | c::_ => c < t.val) 
   | none => True) ∧
  -- Check Right
  (match t.right with 
   | some r => 
       well_formed r ∧ 
       !is_empty_node r ∧ -- CRITICAL
       (∀ s ∈ view r, match s with | [] => False | c::_ => c > t.val) 
   | none => True) ∧
  -- Check Mid
  (match t.mid with 
   | some m => 
       well_formed m ∧ 
       !is_empty_node m -- CRITICAL
   | none => True)
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry

def is_valid_key (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ k ∈ key, 0 ≤ k ∧ k < 256

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_precond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  (match t with
   | some node => well_formed node ∧ !is_empty_node node
   | none => True) ∧
  is_valid_key key -- Match Dafny input constraint
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
theorem node_sizeOf_left (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    sizeOf l < sizeOf (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) := by
  first
  | (simp; done)
  | (simp; omega)
  | omega
  | simp_arith
  | (simp_arith; omega)

theorem node_sizeOf_mid (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    sizeOf m < sizeOf (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) := by
  first
  | (simp; done)
  | (simp; omega)
  | omega
  | simp_arith
  | (simp_arith; omega)

theorem node_sizeOf_right (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    sizeOf r < sizeOf (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) := by
  first
  | (simp; done)
  | (simp; omega)
  | omega
  | simp_arith
  | (simp_arith; omega)

def prune (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) : Option Node :=
  if is_empty_node (Node.mk v b l m r) = true then none else some (Node.mk v b l m r)

def delOpt (o : Option Node) (key : List Int) : Option Node :=
  match o with
  | none => none
  | some (Node.mk v b l m r) =>
    match key with
    | [] => some (Node.mk v b l m r)
    | c :: rest =>
      if c < v then prune v b (delOpt l (c :: rest)) m r
      else if v < c then prune v b l m (delOpt r (c :: rest))
      else
        match rest with
        | [] => prune v false l m r
        | c2 :: rest2 => prune v b l (delOpt m (c2 :: rest2)) r
termination_by sizeOf o
decreasing_by
  all_goals (try simp_wf)
  all_goals first
    | exact node_sizeOf_left _ _ _ _ _
    | exact node_sizeOf_mid _ _ _ _ _
    | exact node_sizeOf_right _ _ _ _ _
    | (simp; omega)
    | omega
    | simp_arith
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def delete (t : Option Node) (key : List Int)
    (h_precond : delete_precond t key) : Option Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  delOpt t key
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- View wrapper for Option Node
def view_opt (t : Option Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  match t with
  | some node => view node
  | none => ∅

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_postcond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) (result : Option Node)
    (_ : delete_precond t key) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (match result with
   | some res => well_formed res ∧ !is_empty_node res
   | none => True) ∧
  view_opt result = view_opt t \ {key}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
@[simp] theorem view_opt_none : view_opt none = ∅ := rfl

@[simp] theorem view_opt_some (n : Node) : view_opt (some n) = view n := rfl

theorem view_eq (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    view (Node.mk v b l m r) =
      view_opt l ∪ view_opt r ∪ ((view_opt m).image (fun s => v :: s)) ∪
        (if b = true then ({[v]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅) := by
  first
  | (rw [view]; cases l <;> cases m <;> cases r <;> rfl)
  | (rw [view.eq_def]; cases l <;> cases m <;> cases r <;> rfl)
  | (rw [view]; cases l <;> cases m <;> cases r <;>
      simp [view_opt, Node.val, Node.is_end, Node.left, Node.mid, Node.right])

theorem wf_eq (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r) ↔
      ((0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256) ∧
       (match l with
        | some lc =>
            well_formed lc ∧ !is_empty_node lc ∧
              (∀ s ∈ view lc, match s with | [] => False | c :: _ => c < v)
        | none => True) ∧
       (match r with
        | some rc =>
            well_formed rc ∧ !is_empty_node rc ∧
              (∀ s ∈ view rc, match s with | [] => False | c :: _ => c > v)
        | none => True) ∧
       (match m with
        | some mc => well_formed mc ∧ !is_empty_node mc
        | none => True)) := by
  first
  | (rw [well_formed]
     all_goals (try simp only [Node.val, Node.left, Node.mid, Node.right])
     all_goals rfl)
  | (rw [well_formed.eq_def]
     all_goals (try simp only [Node.val, Node.left, Node.mid, Node.right])
     all_goals rfl)

theorem not_eq_true_to_false {x : Bool} (h : (!x) = true) : x = false := by
  cases x with
  | false => rfl
  | true => simp at h

theorem false_to_not_eq_true {x : Bool} (h : x = false) : (!x) = true := by
  simp [h]

def wfo (o : Option Node) : Prop :=
  match o with
  | none => True
  | some n => well_formed n ∧ is_empty_node n = false

theorem mem_image_cons {v : Int} {S : Set (List Int)} {s : List Int}
    (h : s ∈ S.image (fun t => v :: t)) : ∃ t, t ∈ S ∧ s = v :: t := by
  rw [Set.mem_image] at h
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hst⟩ := h
  exact ⟨t, ht, hst.symm⟩

theorem mem_end_set {b : Bool} {v : Int} {s : List Int}
    (h : s ∈ (if b = true then ({[v]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅)) : s = [v] := by
  cases b with
  | false => simp at h
  | true => simpa using h

theorem not_mem_end_false {v : Int} {s : List Int}
    (h : s ∈ (if (false : Bool) = true then ({[v]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅)) : False := by
  simp at h

theorem diff_singleton_self (S : Set (List Int)) (x : List Int) (h : x ∉ S) :
    S \ {x} = S := by
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · exact fun hy => hy.1
  · intro hy
    refine ⟨hy, ?_⟩
    rintro rfl
    exact h hy

theorem diff_union_of_not_mem {x : List Int} (A B : Set (List Int)) (h : x ∉ B) :
    (A \ {x}) ∪ B = (A ∪ B) \ {x} := by
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨hy, hne⟩ | hy)
    · exact ⟨Or.inl hy, hne⟩
    · refine ⟨Or.inr hy, ?_⟩
      rintro rfl
      exact h hy
  · rintro ⟨hy | hy, hne⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hy, hne⟩
    · exact Or.inr hy

theorem union_diff_of_not_mem {x : List Int} (A B : Set (List Int)) (h : x ∉ A) :
    A ∪ (B \ {x}) = (A ∪ B) \ {x} := by
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro (hy | ⟨hy, hne⟩)
    · refine ⟨Or.inl hy, ?_⟩
      rintro rfl
      exact h hy
    · exact ⟨Or.inr hy, hne⟩
  · rintro ⟨hy | hy, hne⟩
    · exact Or.inl hy
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hy, hne⟩

theorem end_view_eq (v : Int) (b : Bool) (X : Set (List Int)) (h : [v] ∉ X) :
    X ∪ (if (false : Bool) = true then ({[v]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅)
      = (X ∪ (if b = true then ({[v]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅)) \ {[v]} := by
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro (hy | hy)
    · refine ⟨Or.inl hy, ?_⟩
      rintro rfl
      exact h hy
    · exact absurd (not_mem_end_false hy) (by simp)
  · rintro ⟨hy | hy, hne⟩
    · exact Or.inl hy
    · exact absurd (mem_end_set hy) hne

theorem image_cons_diff (v : Int) (S : Set (List Int)) (t0 : List Int) :
    ((S \ {t0}).image (fun t => v :: t))
      = (S.image (fun t => v :: t)) \ {v :: t0} := by
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, ⟨ht1, ht2⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨t, ht1, rfl⟩, fun hh => ht2 ?_⟩
    simpa using hh
  · rintro ⟨⟨t, ht1, rfl⟩, h2⟩
    refine ⟨t, ⟨ht1, fun hh => h2 ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    simp [hh]

theorem view_prune (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    view_opt (prune v b l m r) = view (Node.mk v b l m r) := by
  cases b <;> cases l <;> cases m <;> cases r <;>
    simp [prune, is_empty_node, Node.is_end, Node.left, Node.mid, Node.right, view_eq]

theorem prune_spec (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    prune v b l m r = none ∨
      (prune v b l m r = some (Node.mk v b l m r) ∧
        is_empty_node (Node.mk v b l m r) = false) := by
  unfold prune
  cases h : is_empty_node (Node.mk v b l m r) with
  | true => left; simp [h]
  | false => right; simp [h]

theorem view_nil_aux : ∀ (n : Nat) (o : Option Node), sizeOf o < n → [] ∉ view_opt o := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro o h; exact absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro o hsz
    cases o with
    | none => simp
    | some node =>
      obtain ⟨v, b, l, m, r⟩ := node
      have hl : [] ∉ view_opt l := by
        refine ih l ?_
        have h1 := node_sizeOf_left v b l m r
        omega
      have hr : [] ∉ view_opt r := by
        refine ih r ?_
        have h1 := node_sizeOf_right v b l m r
        omega
      rw [view_opt_some, view_eq]
      simp only [Set.mem_union, not_or]
      refine ⟨⟨⟨hl, hr⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · intro hmem
        obtain ⟨t, _, ht⟩ := mem_image_cons hmem
        exact absurd ht (by simp)
      · intro hmem
        have hx := mem_end_set hmem
        simp at hx

theorem view_nil_notmem (o : Option Node) : [] ∉ view_opt o :=
  view_nil_aux (sizeOf o + 1) o (by omega)

theorem wf_val (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) : 0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256 := by
  rw [wf_eq] at h
  exact h.1

theorem wf_left (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) : wfo l := by
  rw [wf_eq] at h
  cases l with
  | none => trivial
  | some lc =>
    obtain ⟨-, hl, -, -⟩ := h
    exact ⟨hl.1, not_eq_true_to_false hl.2.1⟩

theorem wf_right (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) : wfo r := by
  rw [wf_eq] at h
  cases r with
  | none => trivial
  | some rc =>
    obtain ⟨-, -, hr, -⟩ := h
    exact ⟨hr.1, not_eq_true_to_false hr.2.1⟩

theorem wf_mid (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) : wfo m := by
  rw [wf_eq] at h
  cases m with
  | none => trivial
  | some mc =>
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, hm⟩ := h
    exact ⟨hm.1, not_eq_true_to_false hm.2⟩

theorem wf_left_ord (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) :
    ∀ s ∈ view_opt l, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → c0 < v := by
  rw [wf_eq] at h
  cases l with
  | none =>
    intro s hs
    simp at hs
  | some lc =>
    obtain ⟨-, hl, -, -⟩ := h
    intro s hs c0 t0 hst
    have h3 := hl.2.2 s hs
    rw [hst] at h3
    exact h3

theorem wf_right_ord (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) :
    ∀ s ∈ view_opt r, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → v < c0 := by
  rw [wf_eq] at h
  cases r with
  | none =>
    intro s hs
    simp at hs
  | some rc =>
    obtain ⟨-, -, hr, -⟩ := h
    intro s hs c0 t0 hst
    have h3 := hr.2.2 s hs
    rw [hst] at h3
    exact h3

theorem wf_mk (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (hv : 0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256)
    (hl : wfo l)
    (hlo : ∀ s ∈ view_opt l, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → c0 < v)
    (hr : wfo r)
    (hro : ∀ s ∈ view_opt r, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → v < c0)
    (hm : wfo m) : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r) := by
  rw [wf_eq]
  refine ⟨hv, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · cases l with
    | none => trivial
    | some lc =>
      refine ⟨hl.1, false_to_not_eq_true hl.2, ?_⟩
      intro s hs
      cases s with
      | nil => exact absurd hs (view_nil_notmem (some lc))
      | cons c0 t0 => exact hlo (c0 :: t0) hs c0 t0 rfl
  · cases r with
    | none => trivial
    | some rc =>
      refine ⟨hr.1, false_to_not_eq_true hr.2, ?_⟩
      intro s hs
      cases s with
      | nil => exact absurd hs (view_nil_notmem (some rc))
      | cons c0 t0 => exact hro (c0 :: t0) hs c0 t0 rfl
  · cases m with
    | none => trivial
    | some mc => exact ⟨hm.1, false_to_not_eq_true hm.2⟩

theorem delOpt_none (key : List Int) : delOpt none key = none := by
  first
  | (rw [delOpt]; all_goals rfl)
  | (simp only [delOpt])
  | (rw [delOpt.eq_def]; all_goals rfl)
  | rfl

theorem delOpt_nil (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    delOpt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) [] = some (Node.mk v b l m r) := by
  first
  | (rw [delOpt]; all_goals rfl)
  | (simp only [delOpt])
  | (rw [delOpt.eq_def]; all_goals rfl)
  | rfl

theorem delOpt_cons (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) (c : Int) (rest : List Int) :
    delOpt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) (c :: rest) =
      (if c < v then prune v b (delOpt l (c :: rest)) m r
       else if v < c then prune v b l m (delOpt r (c :: rest))
       else
         match rest with
         | [] => prune v false l m r
         | c2 :: rest2 => prune v b l (delOpt m (c2 :: rest2)) r) := by
  first
  | (rw [delOpt]; all_goals rfl)
  | (simp only [delOpt])
  | (rw [delOpt.eq_def]; all_goals rfl)
  | rfl

theorem delOpt_single (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) (c : Int) :
    delOpt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) [c] =
      (if c < v then prune v b (delOpt l [c]) m r
       else if v < c then prune v b l m (delOpt r [c])
       else prune v false l m r) := by
  rw [delOpt_cons]
  all_goals rfl

theorem delOpt_cons2 (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (c c2 : Int) (rest2 : List Int) :
    delOpt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) (c :: c2 :: rest2) =
      (if c < v then prune v b (delOpt l (c :: c2 :: rest2)) m r
       else if v < c then prune v b l m (delOpt r (c :: c2 :: rest2))
       else prune v b l (delOpt m (c2 :: rest2)) r) := by
  rw [delOpt_cons]
  all_goals rfl

theorem del_left_case (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r l' : Option Node)
    (c : Int) (rest : List Int) (hc : c < v)
    (hv : 0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256) (hwl : wfo l) (hwm : wfo m) (hwr : wfo r)
    (hlo : ∀ s ∈ view_opt l, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → c0 < v)
    (hro : ∀ s ∈ view_opt r, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → v < c0)
    (hwl' : wfo l') (hvl' : view_opt l' = view_opt l \ {c :: rest}) :
    wfo (prune v b l' m r) ∧
      view_opt (prune v b l' m r) = view_opt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) \ {c :: rest} := by
  have hkr : (c :: rest) ∉ view_opt r := by
    intro hmem
    have h2 := hro (c :: rest) hmem c rest rfl
    omega
  have hkm : (c :: rest) ∉ (view_opt m).image (fun s => v :: s) := by
    intro hmem
    obtain ⟨t, _, ht⟩ := mem_image_cons hmem
    injection ht with h1 h2
    omega
  have hkE : (c :: rest) ∉ (if b = true then ({[v]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅) := by
    intro hmem
    have hx := mem_end_set hmem
    injection hx with h1 h2
    omega
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases prune_spec v b l' m r with hp | ⟨hp, hpne⟩
    · rw [hp]; trivial
    · rw [hp]
      refine ⟨?_, hpne⟩
      refine wf_mk v b l' m r hv hwl' ?_ hwr hro hwm
      intro s hs c0 t0 hst
      rw [hvl'] at hs
      exact hlo s hs.1 c0 t0 hst
  · rw [view_prune]
    simp only [view_opt_some, view_eq, hvl']
    rw [diff_union_of_not_mem _ _ hkr, diff_union_of_not_mem _ _ hkm,
      diff_union_of_not_mem _ _ hkE]

theorem del_right_case (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r r' : Option Node)
    (c : Int) (rest : List Int) (hc : v < c)
    (hv : 0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256) (hwl : wfo l) (hwm : wfo m) (hwr : wfo r)
    (hlo : ∀ s ∈ view_opt l, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → c0 < v)
    (hro : ∀ s ∈ view_opt r, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → v < c0)
    (hwr' : wfo r') (hvr' : view_opt r' = view_opt r \ {c :: rest}) :
    wfo (prune v b l m r') ∧
      view_opt (prune v b l m r') = view_opt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) \ {c :: rest} := by
  have hkl : (c :: rest) ∉ view_opt l := by
    intro hmem
    have h2 := hlo (c :: rest) hmem c rest rfl
    omega
  have hkm : (c :: rest) ∉ (view_opt m).image (fun s => v :: s) := by
    intro hmem
    obtain ⟨t, _, ht⟩ := mem_image_cons hmem
    injection ht with h1 h2
    omega
  have hkE : (c :: rest) ∉ (if b = true then ({[v]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅) := by
    intro hmem
    have hx := mem_end_set hmem
    injection hx with h1 h2
    omega
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases prune_spec v b l m r' with hp | ⟨hp, hpne⟩
    · rw [hp]; trivial
    · rw [hp]
      refine ⟨?_, hpne⟩
      refine wf_mk v b l m r' hv hwl hlo hwr' ?_ hwm
      intro s hs c0 t0 hst
      rw [hvr'] at hs
      exact hro s hs.1 c0 t0 hst
  · rw [view_prune]
    simp only [view_opt_some, view_eq, hvr']
    rw [union_diff_of_not_mem _ _ hkl, diff_union_of_not_mem _ _ hkm,
      diff_union_of_not_mem _ _ hkE]

theorem del_end_case (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (hv : 0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256) (hwl : wfo l) (hwm : wfo m) (hwr : wfo r)
    (hlo : ∀ s ∈ view_opt l, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → c0 < v)
    (hro : ∀ s ∈ view_opt r, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → v < c0) :
    wfo (prune v false l m r) ∧
      view_opt (prune v false l m r) = view_opt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) \ {[v]} := by
  have hkl : [v] ∉ view_opt l := by
    intro hmem

    injection hteq with h1 h2
    have h3 : ([] : List Int) ∈ view_opt m := by rw [h2]; exact ht
    exact view_nil_notmem m h3

theorem del_mid_case (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r m' : Option Node)
    (c2 : Int) (rest2 : List Int)
    (hv : 0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256) (hwl : wfo l) (hwm : wfo m) (hwr : wfo r)
    (hlo : ∀ s ∈ view_opt l, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → c0 < v)
    (hro : ∀ s ∈ view_opt r, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → v < c0)
    (hwm' : wfo m') (hvm' : view_opt m' = view_opt m \ {c2 :: rest2}) :
    wfo (prune v b l m' r) ∧
      view_opt (prune v b l m' r)
        = view_opt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) \ {v :: c2 :: rest2} := by
  have hkl : (v :: c2 :: rest2) ∉ view_opt l := by
    intro hmem
    have h2 := hlo (v :: c2 :: rest2) hmem v (c2 :: rest2) rfl
    omega
  have hkr : (v :: c2 :: rest2) ∉ view_opt r := by
    intro hmem
    have h2 := hro (v :: c2 :: rest2) hmem v (c2 :: rest2) rfl
    omega
  have hkE : (v :: c2 :: rest2) ∉ (if b = true then ({[v]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅) := by
    intro hmem
    have hx := mem_end_set hmem
    simp at hx
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases prune_spec v b l m' r with hp | ⟨hp, hpne⟩
    · rw [hp]; trivial
    · rw [hp]
      exact ⟨wf_mk v b l m' r hv hwl hlo hwr hro hwm', hpne⟩
  · rw [view_prune]
    simp only [view_opt_some, view_eq, hvm']
    rw [image_cons_diff]
    have hkLR : (v :: c2 :: rest2) ∉ view_opt l ∪ view_opt r := by
      simp only [Set.mem_union, not_or]
      exact ⟨hkl, hkr⟩
    rw [union_diff_of_not_mem _ _ hkLR, diff_union_of_not_mem _ _ hkE]

theorem main_aux : ∀ (n : Nat) (o : Option Node) (key : List Int),
    sizeOf o < n → wfo o →
    wfo (delOpt o key) ∧ view_opt (delOpt o key) = view_opt o \ {key} := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro o key h _; exact absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro o key hsz hwf
    cases o with
    | none =>
      rw [delOpt_none]
      refine ⟨trivial, ?_⟩
      simp
    | some node =>
      obtain ⟨v, b, l, m, r⟩ := node
      have hwfN : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r) := hwf.1
      have hv := wf_val v b l m r hwfN
      have hwl := wf_left v b l m r hwfN
      have hwm := wf_mid v b l m r hwfN
      have hwr := wf_right v b l m r hwfN
      have hlo := wf_left_ord v b l m r hwfN
      have hro := wf_right_ord v b l m r hwfN
      have hszl : sizeOf l < n := by
        have h1 := node_sizeOf_left v b l m r
        omega
      have hszm : sizeOf m < n := by
        have h1 := node_sizeOf_mid v b l m r
        omega
      have hszr : sizeOf r < n := by
        have h1 := node_sizeOf_right v b l m r
        omega
      cases key with
      | nil =>
        rw [delOpt_nil]
        refine ⟨hwf, ?_⟩
        rw [diff_singleton_self _ _ (view_nil_notmem (some (Node.mk v b l m r)))]
      | cons c rest =>
        cases rest with
        | nil =>
          rw [delOpt_single]
          by_cases hc1 : c < v
          · rw [if_pos hc1]
            obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih l [c] hszl hwl
            exact del_left_case v b l m r _ c [] hc1 hv hwl hwm hwr hlo hro h1 h2
          · rw [if_neg hc1]
            by_cases hc2 : v < c
            · rw [if_pos hc2]
              obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih r [c] hszr hwr
              exact del_right_case v b l m r _ c [] hc2 hv hwl hwm hwr hlo hro h1 h2
            · rw [if_neg hc2]
              have hcv : c = v := by omega
              rw [hcv]
              exact del_end_case v b l m r hv hwl hwm hwr hlo hro
        | cons c2 rest2 =>
          rw [delOpt_cons2]
          by_cases hc1 : c < v
          · rw [if_pos hc1]
            obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih l (c :: c2 :: rest2) hszl hwl
            exact del_left_case v b l m r _ c (c2 :: rest2) hc1 hv hwl hwm hwr hlo hro h1 h2
          · rw [if_neg hc1]
            by_cases hc2 : v < c
            · rw [if_pos hc2]
              obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih r (c :: c2 :: rest2) hszr hwr
              exact del_right_case v b l m r _ c (c2 :: rest2) hc2 hv hwl hwm hwr hlo hro h1 h2
            · rw [if_neg hc2]
              have hcv : c = v := by omega
              rw [hcv]
              obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih m (c2 :: rest2) hszm hwm
              exact del_mid_case v b l m r _ c2 rest2 hv hwl hwm hwr hlo hro h1 h2
-- !benchmark @end lemma

theorem delete_postcond_satisfied (t : Option Node) (key : List Int)
    (h_precond : delete_precond t key) :
    delete_postcond t key (delete t key h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof

    cases t with

    | none => trivial

      have H1 := H.1
      have hdd : delOpt t key = some node := hd
      rw [hdd] at H1
      exact ⟨H1.1, false_to_not_eq_true H1.2⟩
  · exact H.2
  -- !benchmark @end proof

        | c2 :: rest2 => prune v b l (delOpt m (c2 :: rest2)) r
termination_by sizeOf o
decreasing_by
  all_goals (try simp_wf)
  all_goals first
    | exact node_sizeOf_left _ _ _ _ _
    | exact node_sizeOf_mid _ _ _ _ _
    | exact node_sizeOf_right _ _ _ _ _
    | (simp; omega)
    | omega
    | simp_arith
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def delete (t : Option Node) (key : List Int)
    (h_precond : delete_precond t key) : Option Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  delOpt t key
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- View wrapper for Option Node
def view_opt (t : Option Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  match t with
  | some node => view node
  | none => ∅

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_postcond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) (result : Option Node)
    (_ : delete_precond t key) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (match result with
   | some res => well_formed res ∧ !is_empty_node res
   | none => True) ∧
  view_opt result = view_opt t \ {key}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
@[simp] theorem view_opt_none : view_opt none = ∅ := rfl

@[simp] theorem view_opt_some (n : Node) : view_opt (some n) = view n := rfl

theorem view_eq (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    view (Node.mk v b l m r) =
      view_opt l ∪ view_opt r ∪ ((view_opt m).image (fun s => v :: s)) ∪
        (if b = true then ({[v]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅) := by
  first
  | (rw [view]; cases l <;> cases m <;> cases r <;> rfl)
  | (rw [view.eq_def]; cases l <;> cases m <;> cases r <;> rfl)
  | (rw [view]; cases l <;> cases m <;> cases r <;>
      simp [view_opt, Node.val, Node.is_end, Node.left, Node.mid, Node.right])

theorem wf_eq (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r) ↔
      ((0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256) ∧
       (match l with
        | some lc =>
            well_formed lc ∧ !is_empty_node lc ∧
              (∀ s ∈ view lc, match s with | [] => False | c :: _ => c < v)
        | none => True) ∧
       (match r with
        | some rc =>
            well_formed rc ∧ !is_empty_node rc ∧
              (∀ s ∈ view rc, match s with | [] => False | c :: _ => c > v)
        | none => True) ∧
       (match m with
        | some mc => well_formed mc ∧ !is_empty_node mc
        | none => True)) := by
  first
  | (rw [well_formed]
     all_goals (try simp only [Node.val, Node.left, Node.mid, Node.right])
     all_goals rfl)
  | (rw [well_formed.eq_def]
     all_goals (try simp only [Node.val, Node.left, Node.mid, Node.right])
     all_goals rfl)

theorem not_eq_true_to_false {x : Bool} (h : (!x) = true) : x = false := by
  cases x with
  | false => rfl
  | true => simp at h

theorem false_to_not_eq_true {x : Bool} (h : x = false) : (!x) = true := by
  simp [h]

def wfo (o : Option Node) : Prop :=
  match o with
  | none => True
  | some n => well_formed n ∧ is_empty_node n = false

theorem mem_image_cons {v : Int} {S : Set (List Int)} {s : List Int}
    (h : s ∈ S.image (fun t => v :: t)) : ∃ t, t ∈ S ∧ s = v :: t := by
  rw [Set.mem_image] at h
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hst⟩ := h
  exact ⟨t, ht, hst.symm⟩

theorem mem_end_set {b : Bool} {v : Int} {s : List Int}
    (h : s ∈ (if b = true then ({[v]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅)) : s = [v] := by
  cases b with
  | false => simp at h
  | true => simpa using h

theorem not_mem_end_false {v : Int} {s : List Int}
    (h : s ∈ (if (false : Bool) = true then ({[v]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅)) : False := by
  simp at h

theorem diff_singleton_self (S : Set (List Int)) (x : List Int) (h : x ∉ S) :
    S \ {x} = S := by
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · exact fun hy => hy.1
  · intro hy
    refine ⟨hy, ?_⟩
    rintro rfl
    exact h hy

theorem diff_union_of_not_mem {x : List Int} (A B : Set (List Int)) (h : x ∉ B) :
    (A \ {x}) ∪ B = (A ∪ B) \ {x} := by
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨hy, hne⟩ | hy)
    · exact ⟨Or.inl hy, hne⟩
    · refine ⟨Or.inr hy, ?_⟩
      rintro rfl
      exact h hy
  · rintro ⟨hy | hy, hne⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hy, hne⟩
    · exact Or.inr hy

theorem union_diff_of_not_mem {x : List Int} (A B : Set (List Int)) (h : x ∉ A) :
    A ∪ (B \ {x}) = (A ∪ B) \ {x} := by
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro (hy | ⟨hy, hne⟩)
    · refine ⟨Or.inl hy, ?_⟩
      rintro rfl
      exact h hy
    · exact ⟨Or.inr hy, hne⟩
  · rintro ⟨hy | hy, hne⟩
    · exact Or.inl hy
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hy, hne⟩

theorem end_view_eq (v : Int) (b : Bool) (X : Set (List Int)) (h : [v] ∉ X) :
    X ∪ (if (false : Bool) = true then ({[v]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅)
      = (X ∪ (if b = true then ({[v]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅)) \ {[v]} := by
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro (hy | hy)
    · refine ⟨Or.inl hy, ?_⟩
      rintro rfl
      exact h hy
    · exact absurd (not_mem_end_false hy) (by simp)
  · rintro ⟨hy | hy, hne⟩
    · exact Or.inl hy
    · exact absurd (mem_end_set hy) hne

theorem image_cons_diff (v : Int) (S : Set (List Int)) (t0 : List Int) :
    ((S \ {t0}).image (fun t => v :: t))
      = (S.image (fun t => v :: t)) \ {v :: t0} := by
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, ⟨ht1, ht2⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨t, ht1, rfl⟩, fun hh => ht2 ?_⟩
    simpa using hh
  · rintro ⟨⟨t, ht1, rfl⟩, h2⟩
    refine ⟨t, ⟨ht1, fun hh => h2 ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    simp [hh]

theorem view_prune (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    view_opt (prune v b l m r) = view (Node.mk v b l m r) := by
  cases b <;> cases l <;> cases m <;> cases r <;>
    simp [prune, is_empty_node, Node.is_end, Node.left, Node.mid, Node.right, view_eq]

theorem prune_spec (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    prune v b l m r = none ∨
      (prune v b l m r = some (Node.mk v b l m r) ∧
        is_empty_node (Node.mk v b l m r) = false) := by
  unfold prune
  cases h : is_empty_node (Node.mk v b l m r) with
  | true => left; simp [h]
  | false => right; simp [h]

theorem view_nil_aux : ∀ (n : Nat) (o : Option Node), sizeOf o < n → [] ∉ view_opt o := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro o h; exact absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro o hsz
    cases o with
    | none => simp
    | some node =>
      obtain ⟨v, b, l, m, r⟩ := node
      have hl : [] ∉ view_opt l := by
        refine ih l ?_
        have h1 := node_sizeOf_left v b l m r
        omega
      have hr : [] ∉ view_opt r := by
        refine ih r ?_
        have h1 := node_sizeOf_right v b l m r
        omega
      rw [view_opt_some, view_eq]
      simp only [Set.mem_union, not_or]
      refine ⟨⟨⟨hl, hr⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · intro hmem
        obtain ⟨t, _, ht⟩ := mem_image_cons hmem
        exact absurd ht (by simp)
      · intro hmem
        have hx := mem_end_set hmem
        simp at hx

theorem view_nil_notmem (o : Option Node) : [] ∉ view_opt o :=
  view_nil_aux (sizeOf o + 1) o (by omega)

theorem wf_val (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) : 0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256 := by
  rw [wf_eq] at h
  exact h.1

theorem wf_left (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) : wfo l := by
  rw [wf_eq] at h
  cases l with
  | none => trivial
  | some lc =>
    obtain ⟨-, hl, -, -⟩ := h
    exact ⟨hl.1, not_eq_true_to_false hl.2.1⟩

theorem wf_right (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) : wfo r := by
  rw [wf_eq] at h
  cases r with
  | none => trivial
  | some rc =>
    obtain ⟨-, -, hr, -⟩ := h
    exact ⟨hr.1, not_eq_true_to_false hr.2.1⟩

theorem wf_mid (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) : wfo m := by
  rw [wf_eq] at h
  cases m with
  | none => trivial
  | some mc =>
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, hm⟩ := h
    exact ⟨hm.1, not_eq_true_to_false hm.2⟩

theorem wf_left_ord (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) :
    ∀ s ∈ view_opt l, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → c0 < v := by
  rw [wf_eq] at h
  cases l with
  | none =>
    intro s hs
    simp at hs
  | some lc =>
    obtain ⟨-, hl, -, -⟩ := h
    intro s hs c0 t0 hst
    have h3 := hl.2.2 s hs
    rw [hst] at h3
    exact h3

theorem wf_right_ord (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) :
    ∀ s ∈ view_opt r, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → v < c0 := by
  rw [wf_eq] at h
  cases r with
  | none =>
    intro s hs
    simp at hs
  | some rc =>
    obtain ⟨-, -, hr, -⟩ := h
    intro s hs c0 t0 hst
    have h3 := hr.2.2 s hs
    rw [hst] at h3
    exact h3

theorem wf_mk (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (hv : 0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256)
    (hl : wfo l)
    (hlo : ∀ s ∈ view_opt l, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → c0 < v)
    (hr : wfo r)
    (hro : ∀ s ∈ view_opt r, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → v < c0)
    (hm : wfo m) : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r) := by
  rw [wf_eq]
  refine ⟨hv, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · cases l with
    | none => trivial
    | some lc =>
      refine ⟨hl.1, false_to_not_eq_true hl.2, ?_⟩
      intro s hs
      cases s with
      | nil => exact absurd hs (view_nil_notmem (some lc))
      | cons c0 t0 => exact hlo (c0 :: t0) hs c0 t0 rfl
  · cases r with
    | none => trivial
    | some rc =>
      refine ⟨hr.1, false_to_not_eq_true hr.2, ?_⟩
      intro s hs
      cases s with
      | nil => exact absurd hs (view_nil_notmem (some rc))
      | cons c0 t0 => exact hro (c0 :: t0) hs c0 t0 rfl
  · cases m with
    | none => trivial
    | some mc => exact ⟨hm.1, false_to_not_eq_true hm.2⟩

theorem delOpt_none (key : List Int) : delOpt none key = none := by
  first
  | (rw [delOpt]; all_goals rfl)
  | (simp only [delOpt])
  | (rw [delOpt.eq_def]; all_goals rfl)
  | rfl

theorem delOpt_nil (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    delOpt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) [] = some (Node.mk v b l m r) := by
  first
  | (rw [delOpt]; all_goals rfl)
  | (simp only [delOpt])
  | (rw [delOpt.eq_def]; all_goals rfl)
  | rfl

theorem delOpt_cons (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) (c : Int) (rest : List Int) :
    delOpt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) (c :: rest) =
      (if c < v then prune v b (delOpt l (c :: rest)) m r
       else if v < c then prune v b l m (delOpt r (c :: rest))
       else
         match rest with
         | [] => prune v false l m r
         | c2 :: rest2 => prune v b l (delOpt m (c2 :: rest2)) r) := by
  first
  | (rw [delOpt]; all_goals rfl)
  | (simp only [delOpt])
  | (rw [delOpt.eq_def]; all_goals rfl)
  | rfl

theorem delOpt_single (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) (c : Int) :
    delOpt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) [c] =
      (if c < v then prune v b (delOpt l [c]) m r
       else if v < c then prune v b l m (delOpt r [c])
       else prune v false l m r) := by
  rw [delOpt_cons]
  all_goals rfl

theorem delOpt_cons2 (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (c c2 : Int) (rest2 : List Int) :
    delOpt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) (c :: c2 :: rest2) =
      (if c < v then prune v b (delOpt l (c :: c2 :: rest2)) m r
       else if v < c then prune v b l m (delOpt r (c :: c2 :: rest2))
       else prune v b l (delOpt m (c2 :: rest2)) r) := by
  rw [delOpt_cons]
  all_goals rfl

theorem del_left_case (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r l' : Option Node)
    (c : Int) (rest : List Int) (hc : c < v)
    (hv : 0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256) (hwl : wfo l) (hwm : wfo m) (hwr : wfo r)
    (hlo : ∀ s ∈ view_opt l, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → c0 < v)
    (hro : ∀ s ∈ view_opt r, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → v < c0)
    (hwl' : wfo l') (hvl' : view_opt l' = view_opt l \ {c :: rest}) :
    wfo (prune v b l' m r) ∧
      view_opt (prune v b l' m r) = view_opt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) \ {c :: rest} := by
  have hkr : (c :: rest) ∉ view_opt r := by
    intro hmem
    have h2 := hro (c :: rest) hmem c rest rfl
    omega
  have hkm : (c :: rest) ∉ (view_opt m).image (fun s => v :: s) := by
    intro hmem
    obtain ⟨t, _, ht⟩ := mem_image_cons hmem
    injection ht with h1 h2
    omega
  have hkE : (c :: rest) ∉ (if b = true then ({[v]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅) := by
    intro hmem
    have hx := mem_end_set hmem
    injection hx with h1 h2
    omega
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases prune_spec v b l' m r with hp | ⟨hp, hpne⟩
    · rw [hp]; trivial
    · rw [hp]
      refine ⟨?_, hpne⟩
      refine wf_mk v b l' m r hv hwl' ?_ hwr hro hwm
      intro s hs c0 t0 hst
      rw [hvl'] at hs
      exact hlo s hs.1 c0 t0 hst
  · rw [view_prune]
    simp only [view_opt_some, view_eq, hvl']
    rw [diff_union_of_not_mem _ _ hkr, diff_union_of_not_mem _ _ hkm,
      diff_union_of_not_mem _ _ hkE]

theorem del_right_case (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r r' : Option Node)
    (c : Int) (rest : List Int) (hc : v < c)
    (hv : 0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256) (hwl : wfo l) (hwm : wfo m) (hwr : wfo r)
    (hlo : ∀ s ∈ view_opt l, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → c0 < v)
    (hro : ∀ s ∈ view_opt r, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → v < c0)
    (hwr' : wfo r') (hvr' : view_opt r' = view_opt r \ {c :: rest}) :
    wfo (prune v b l m r') ∧
      view_opt (prune v b l m r') = view_opt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) \ {c :: rest} := by
  have hkl : (c :: rest) ∉ view_opt l := by
    intro hmem
    have h2 := hlo (c :: rest) hmem c rest rfl
    omega
  have hkm : (c :: rest) ∉ (view_opt m).image (fun s => v :: s) := by
    intro hmem
    obtain ⟨t, _, ht⟩ := mem_image_cons hmem
    injection ht with h1 h2
    omega
  have hkE : (c :: rest) ∉ (if b = true then ({[v]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅) := by
    intro hmem
    have hx := mem_end_set hmem
    injection hx with h1 h2
    omega
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases prune_spec v b l m r' with hp | ⟨hp, hpne⟩
    · rw [hp]; trivial
    · rw [hp]
      refine ⟨?_, hpne⟩
      refine wf_mk v b l m r' hv hwl hlo hwr' ?_ hwm
      intro s hs c0 t0 hst
      rw [hvr'] at hs
      exact hro s hs.1 c0 t0 hst
  · rw [view_prune]
    simp only [view_opt_some, view_eq, hvr']
    rw [union_diff_of_not_mem _ _ hkl, diff_union_of_not_mem _ _ hkm,
      diff_union_of_not_mem _ _ hkE]

theorem del_end_case (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (hv : 0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256) (hwl : wfo l) (hwm : wfo m) (hwr : wfo r)
    (hlo : ∀ s ∈ view_opt l, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → c0 < v)
    (hro : ∀ s ∈ view_opt r, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → v < c0) :
    wfo (prune v false l m r) ∧
      view_opt (prune v false l m r) = view_opt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) \ {[v]} := by
  have hkl : [v] ∉ view_opt l := by
    intro hmem
    have h2 := hlo [v] hmem v [] rfl
    omega
  have hkr : [v] ∉ view_opt r := by
    intro hmem
    have h2 := hro [v] hmem v [] rfl
    omega
  have hkm : [v] ∉ (view_opt m).image (fun s => v :: s) := by
    intro hmem
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hteq⟩ := mem_image_cons hmem
    injection hteq with h1 h2
    have h3 : ([] : List Int) ∈ view_opt m := by rw [h2]; exact ht
    exact view_nil_notmem m h3
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases prune_spec v false l m r with hp | ⟨hp, hpne⟩
    · rw [hp]; trivial
    · rw [hp]
      exact ⟨wf_mk v false l m r hv hwl hlo hwr hro hwm, hpne⟩
  · have hL := view_eq v false l m r
    have hR := view_eq v b l m r
    rw [view_prune, hL, view_opt_some, hR]
    have hkX : [v] ∉ view_opt l ∪ view_opt r ∪ ((view_opt m).image (fun s => v :: s)) := by
      simp only [Set.mem_union, not_or]
      exact ⟨⟨hkl, hkr⟩, hkm⟩
    exact end_view_eq v b _ hkX

theorem del_mid_case (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r m' : Option Node)
    (c2 : Int) (rest2 : List Int)
    (hv : 0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256) (hwl : wfo l) (hwm : wfo m) (hwr : wfo r)
    (hlo : ∀ s ∈ view_opt l, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → c0 < v)
    (hro : ∀ s ∈ view_opt r, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → v < c0)
    (hwm' : wfo m') (hvm' : view_opt m' = view_opt m \ {c2 :: rest2}) :
    wfo (prune v b l m' r) ∧
      view_opt (prune v b l m' r)
        = view_opt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) \ {v :: c2 :: rest2} := by
  have hkl : (v :: c2 :: rest2) ∉ view_opt l := by
    intro hmem
    have h2 := hlo (v :: c2 :: rest2) hmem v (c2 :: rest2) rfl
    omega
  have hkr : (v :: c2 :: rest2) ∉ view_opt r := by
    intro hmem
    have h2 := hro (v :: c2 :: rest2) hmem v (c2 :: rest2) rfl
    omega
  have hkE : (v :: c2 :: rest2) ∉ (if b = true then ({[v]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅) := by
    intro hmem
    have hx := mem_end_set hmem
    simp at hx
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases prune_spec v b l m' r with hp | ⟨hp, hpne⟩
    · rw [hp]; trivial
    · rw [hp]
      exact ⟨wf_mk v b l m' r hv hwl hlo hwr hro hwm', hpne⟩
  · rw [view_prune]
    simp only [view_opt_some, view_eq, hvm']
    rw [image_cons_diff]
    have hkLR : (v :: c2 :: rest2) ∉ view_opt l ∪ view_opt r := by
      simp only [Set.mem_union, not_or]
      exact ⟨hkl, hkr⟩
    rw [union_diff_of_not_mem _ _ hkLR, diff_union_of_not_mem _ _ hkE]

theorem main_aux : ∀ (n : Nat) (o : Option Node) (key : List Int),
    sizeOf o < n → wfo o →
    wfo (delOpt o key) ∧ view_opt (delOpt o key) = view_opt o \ {key} := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro o key h _; exact absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro o key hsz hwf
    cases o with
    | none =>
      rw [delOpt_none]
      refine ⟨trivial, ?_⟩
      simp

def left (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ l _ _ => l

def mid (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ _ m _ => m

def right (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ _ _ r => r

def view (t : Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  let l := match t.left with | some child => view child | none => ∅
  let r := match t.right with | some child => view child | none => ∅
  let m := match t.mid with | some child => (view child).image (fun s => t.val :: s) | none => ∅

  l ∪ r ∪ m ∪ current

decreasing_by all_goals sorry

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_precond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  (match t with
   | some node => well_formed node ∧ !is_empty_node node
   | none => True) ∧
  is_valid_key key -- Match Dafny input constraint
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
theorem node_sizeOf_left (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    sizeOf l < sizeOf (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) := by
  first
  | (simp; done)
  | (simp; omega)
  | omega
  | simp_arith
  | (simp_arith; omega)

theorem node_sizeOf_mid (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    sizeOf m < sizeOf (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) := by
  first
  | (simp; done)
  | (simp; omega)
  | omega
  | simp_arith
  | (simp_arith; omega)

theorem node_sizeOf_right (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    sizeOf r < sizeOf (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) := by
  first
  | (simp; done)
  | (simp; omega)
  | omega
  | simp_arith
  | (simp_arith; omega)

def prune (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) : Option Node :=
  if is_empty_node (Node.mk v b l m r) = true then none else some (Node.mk v b l m r)

def delOpt (o : Option Node) (key : List Int) : Option Node :=
  match o with
  | none => none
  | some (Node.mk v b l m r) =>
    match key with
    | [] => some (Node.mk v b l m r)
    | c :: rest =>
      if c < v then prune v b (delOpt l (c :: rest)) m r
      else if v < c then prune v b l m (delOpt r (c :: rest))
      else
        match rest with
        | [] => prune v false l m r
        | c2 :: rest2 => prune v b l (delOpt m (c2 :: rest2)) r
termination_by sizeOf o
decreasing_by
  all_goals (try simp_wf)
  all_goals first
    | exact node_sizeOf_left _ _ _ _ _
    | exact node_sizeOf_mid _ _ _ _ _
    | exact node_sizeOf_right _ _ _ _ _
    | (simp; omega)
    | omega
    | simp_arith
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def delete (t : Option Node) (key : List Int)
    (h_precond : delete_precond t key) : Option Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  delOpt t key
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- View wrapper for Option Node
def view_opt (t : Option Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  match t with
  | some node => view node
  | none => ∅

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_postcond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) (result : Option Node)
    (_ : delete_precond t key) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (match result with
   | some res => well_formed res ∧ !is_empty_node res
   | none => True) ∧
  view_opt result = view_opt t \ {key}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
@[simp] theorem view_opt_none : view_opt none = ∅ := rfl

@[simp] theorem view_opt_some (n : Node) : view_opt (some n) = view n := rfl

theorem view_eq (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    view (Node.mk v b l m r) =
      view_opt l ∪ view_opt r ∪ ((view_opt m).image (fun s => v :: s)) ∪
        (if b = true then ({[v]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅) := by
  first
  | (rw [view]; cases l <;> cases m <;> cases r <;> rfl)
  | (rw [view.eq_def]; cases l <;> cases m <;> cases r <;> rfl)
  | (rw [view]; cases l <;> cases m <;> cases r <;>
      simp [view_opt, Node.val, Node.is_end, Node.left, Node.mid, Node.right])

theorem wf_eq (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r) ↔
      ((0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256) ∧
       (match l with
        | some lc =>
            well_formed lc ∧ !is_empty_node lc ∧
              (∀ s ∈ view lc, match s with | [] => False | c :: _ => c < v)
        | none => True) ∧
       (match r with
        | some rc =>
            well_formed rc ∧ !is_empty_node rc ∧
              (∀ s ∈ view rc, match s with | [] => False | c :: _ => c > v)
        | none => True) ∧
       (match m with
        | some mc => well_formed mc ∧ !is_empty_node mc
        | none => True)) := by
  first
  | (rw [well_formed]
     all_goals (try simp only [Node.val, Node.left, Node.mid, Node.right])
     all_goals rfl)
  | (rw [well_formed.eq_def]
     all_goals (try simp only [Node.val, Node.left, Node.mid, Node.right])
     all_goals rfl)

theorem not_eq_true_to_false {x : Bool} (h : (!x) = true) : x = false := by
  cases x with
  | false => rfl
  | true => simp at h

theorem false_to_not_eq_true {x : Bool} (h : x = false) : (!x) = true := by
  simp [h]

def wfo (o : Option Node) : Prop :=
  match o with
  | none => True
  | some n => well_formed n ∧ is_empty_node n = false

theorem mem_image_cons {v : Int} {S : Set (List Int)} {s : List Int}
    (h : s ∈ S.image (fun t => v :: t)) : ∃ t, t ∈ S ∧ s = v :: t := by
  rw [Set.mem_image] at h
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hst⟩ := h
  exact ⟨t, ht, hst.symm⟩

theorem mem_end_set {b : Bool} {v : Int} {s : List Int}
    (h : s ∈ (if b = true then ({[v]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅)) : s = [v] := by
  cases b with
  | false => simp at h
  | true => simpa using h

theorem not_mem_end_false {v : Int} {s : List Int}
    (h : s ∈ (if (false : Bool) = true then ({[v]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅)) : False := by
  simp at h

theorem diff_singleton_self (S : Set (List Int)) (x : List Int) (h : x ∉ S) :
    S \ {x} = S := by
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · exact fun hy => hy.1
  · intro hy
    refine ⟨hy, ?_⟩
    rintro rfl
    exact h hy

theorem diff_union_of_not_mem {x : List Int} (A B : Set (List Int)) (h : x ∉ B) :
    (A \ {x}) ∪ B = (A ∪ B) \ {x} := by
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨hy, hne⟩ | hy)
    · exact ⟨Or.inl hy, hne⟩
    · refine ⟨Or.inr hy, ?_⟩
      rintro rfl
      exact h hy
  · rintro ⟨hy | hy, hne⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hy, hne⟩
    · exact Or.inr hy

theorem union_diff_of_not_mem {x : List Int} (A B : Set (List Int)) (h : x ∉ A) :
    A ∪ (B \ {x}) = (A ∪ B) \ {x} := by
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro (hy | ⟨hy, hne⟩)
    · refine ⟨Or.inl hy, ?_⟩
      rintro rfl
      exact h hy
    · exact ⟨Or.inr hy, hne⟩
  · rintro ⟨hy | hy, hne⟩
    · exact Or.inl hy
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hy, hne⟩

theorem end_view_eq (v : Int) (b : Bool) (X : Set (List Int)) (h : [v] ∉ X) :
    X ∪ (if (false : Bool) = true then ({[v]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅)
      = (X ∪ (if b = true then ({[v]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅)) \ {[v]} := by
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro (hy | hy)
    · refine ⟨Or.inl hy, ?_⟩
      rintro rfl
      exact h hy
    · exact absurd (not_mem_end_false hy) (by simp)
  · rintro ⟨hy | hy, hne⟩
    · exact Or.inl hy
    · exact absurd (mem_end_set hy) hne

theorem image_cons_diff (v : Int) (S : Set (List Int)) (t0 : List Int) :
    ((S \ {t0}).image (fun t => v :: t))
      = (S.image (fun t => v :: t)) \ {v :: t0} := by
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, ⟨ht1, ht2⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨t, ht1, rfl⟩, fun hh => ht2 ?_⟩
    simpa using hh
  · rintro ⟨⟨t, ht1, rfl⟩, h2⟩
    refine ⟨t, ⟨ht1, fun hh => h2 ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    simp [hh]

theorem view_prune (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    view_opt (prune v b l m r) = view (Node.mk v b l m r) := by
  cases b <;> cases l <;> cases m <;> cases r <;>
    simp [prune, is_empty_node, Node.is_end, Node.left, Node.mid, Node.right, view_eq]

theorem prune_spec (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    prune v b l m r = none ∨
      (prune v b l m r = some (Node.mk v b l m r) ∧
        is_empty_node (Node.mk v b l m r) = false) := by
  unfold prune
  cases h : is_empty_node (Node.mk v b l m r) with
  | true => left; simp [h]
  | false => right; simp [h]

theorem view_nil_aux : ∀ (n : Nat) (o : Option Node), sizeOf o < n → [] ∉ view_opt o := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro o h; exact absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro o hsz
    cases o with
    | none => simp
    | some node =>
      obtain ⟨v, b, l, m, r⟩ := node
      have hl : [] ∉ view_opt l := by
        refine ih l ?_
        have h1 := node_sizeOf_left v b l m r
        omega
      have hr : [] ∉ view_opt r := by
        refine ih r ?_
        have h1 := node_sizeOf_right v b l m r
        omega
      rw [view_opt_some, view_eq]
      simp only [Set.mem_union, not_or]
      refine ⟨⟨⟨hl, hr⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · intro hmem
        obtain ⟨t, _, ht⟩ := mem_image_cons hmem
        exact absurd ht (by simp)
      · intro hmem
        have hx := mem_end_set hmem
        simp at hx

theorem view_nil_notmem (o : Option Node) : [] ∉ view_opt o :=
  view_nil_aux (sizeOf o + 1) o (by omega)

theorem wf_val (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) : 0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256 := by
  rw [wf_eq] at h
  exact h.1

theorem wf_left (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) : wfo l := by
  rw [wf_eq] at h
  cases l with
  | none => trivial
  | some lc =>
    obtain ⟨-, hl, -, -⟩ := h
    exact ⟨hl.1, not_eq_true_to_false hl.2.1⟩

theorem wf_right (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) : wfo r := by
  rw [wf_eq] at h
  cases r with
  | none => trivial
  | some rc =>
    obtain ⟨-, -, hr, -⟩ := h
    exact ⟨hr.1, not_eq_true_to_false hr.2.1⟩

theorem wf_mid (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) : wfo m := by
  rw [wf_eq] at h
  cases m with
  | none => trivial
  | some mc =>
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, hm⟩ := h
    exact ⟨hm.1, not_eq_true_to_false hm.2⟩

theorem wf_left_ord (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) :
    ∀ s ∈ view_opt l, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → c0 < v := by
  rw [wf_eq] at h
  cases l with
  | none =>
    intro s hs
    simp at hs
  | some lc =>
    obtain ⟨-, hl, -, -⟩ := h
    intro s hs c0 t0 hst
    have h3 := hl.2.2 s hs
    rw [hst] at h3
    exact h3

theorem wf_right_ord (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) :
    ∀ s ∈ view_opt r, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → v < c0 := by
  rw [wf_eq] at h
  cases r with
  | none =>
    intro s hs
    simp at hs
  | some rc =>
    obtain ⟨-, -, hr, -⟩ := h
    intro s hs c0 t0 hst
    have h3 := hr.2.2 s hs
    rw [hst] at h3
    exact h3

theorem wf_mk (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (hv : 0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256)
    (hl : wfo l)
    (hlo : ∀ s ∈ view_opt l, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → c0 < v)
    (hr : wfo r)
    (hro : ∀ s ∈ view_opt r, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → v < c0)
    (hm : wfo m) : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r) := by
  rw [wf_eq]
  refine ⟨hv, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · cases l with
    | none => trivial
    | some lc =>
      refine ⟨hl.1, false_to_not_eq_true hl.2, ?_⟩
      intro s hs
      cases s with
      | nil => exact absurd hs (view_nil_notmem (some lc))
      | cons c0 t0 => exact hlo (c0 :: t0) hs c0 t0 rfl
  · cases r with
    | none => trivial
    | some rc =>
      refine ⟨hr.1, false_to_not_eq_true hr.2, ?_⟩
      intro s hs
      cases s with
      | nil => exact absurd hs (view_nil_notmem (some rc))
      | cons c0 t0 => exact hro (c0 :: t0) hs c0 t0 rfl
  · cases m with
    | none => trivial
    | some mc => exact ⟨hm.1, false_to_not_eq_true hm.2⟩

theorem delOpt_none (key : List Int) : delOpt none key = none := by
  first
  | (rw [delOpt]; all_goals rfl)
  | (simp only [delOpt])
  | (rw [delOpt.eq_def]; all_goals rfl)
  | rfl

theorem delOpt_nil (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    delOpt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) [] = some (Node.mk v b l m r) := by
  first
  | (rw [delOpt]; all_goals rfl)
  | (simp only [delOpt])
  | (rw [delOpt.eq_def]; all_goals rfl)
  | rfl

theorem delOpt_cons (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) (c : Int) (rest : List Int) :
    delOpt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) (c :: rest) =
      (if c < v then prune v b (delOpt l (c :: rest)) m r
       else if v < c then prune v b l m (delOpt r (c :: rest))
       else
         match rest with
         | [] => prune v false l m r
         | c2 :: rest2 => prune v b l (delOpt m (c2 :: rest2)) r) := by
  first
  | (rw [delOpt]; all_goals rfl)
  | (simp only [delOpt])
  | (rw [delOpt.eq_def]; all_goals rfl)
  | rfl

theorem delOpt_single (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) (c : Int) :
    delOpt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) [c] =
      (if c < v then prune v b (delOpt l [c]) m r
       else if v < c then prune v b l m (delOpt r [c])
       else prune v false l m r) := by
  rw [delOpt_cons]
  all_goals rfl

theorem delOpt_cons2 (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (c c2 : Int) (rest2 : List Int) :
    delOpt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) (c :: c2 :: rest2) =
      (if c < v then prune v b (delOpt l (c :: c2 :: rest2)) m r
       else if v < c then prune v b l m (delOpt r (c :: c2 :: rest2))
       else prune v b l (delOpt m (c2 :: rest2)) r) := by
  rw [delOpt_cons]
  all_goals rfl

theorem del_left_case (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r l' : Option Node)
    (c : Int) (rest : List Int) (hc : c < v)
    (hv : 0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256) (hwl : wfo l) (hwm : wfo m) (hwr : wfo r)
    (hlo : ∀ s ∈ view_opt l, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → c0 < v)
    (hro : ∀ s ∈ view_opt r, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → v < c0)
    (hwl' : wfo l') (hvl' : view_opt l' = view_opt l \ {c :: rest}) :
    wfo (prune v b l' m r) ∧
      view_opt (prune v b l' m r) = view_opt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) \ {c :: rest} := by
  have hkr : (c :: rest) ∉ view_opt r := by
    intro hmem
    have h2 := hro (c :: rest) hmem c rest rfl
    omega
  have hkm : (c :: rest) ∉ (view_opt m).image (fun s => v :: s) := by
    intro hmem
    obtain ⟨t, _, ht⟩ := mem_image_cons hmem
    injection ht with h1 h2
    omega
  have hkE : (c :: rest) ∉ (if b = true then ({[v]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅) := by
    intro hmem
    have hx := mem_end_set hmem
    injection hx with h1 h2
    omega
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases prune_spec v b l' m r with hp | ⟨hp, hpne⟩
    · rw [hp]; trivial
    · rw [hp]
      refine ⟨?_, hpne⟩
      refine wf_mk v b l' m r hv hwl' ?_ hwr hro hwm
      intro s hs c0 t0 hst
      rw [hvl'] at hs
      exact hlo s hs.1 c0 t0 hst
  · rw [view_prune]
    simp only [view_opt_some, view_eq, hvl']
    rw [diff_union_of_not_mem _ _ hkr, diff_union_of_not_mem _ _ hkm,
      diff_union_of_not_mem _ _ hkE]

theorem del_right_case (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r r' : Option Node)
    (c : Int) (rest : List Int) (hc : v < c)
    (hv : 0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256) (hwl : wfo l) (hwm : wfo m) (hwr : wfo r)
    (hlo : ∀ s ∈ view_opt l, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → c0 < v)
    (hro : ∀ s ∈ view_opt r, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → v < c0)
    (hwr' : wfo r') (hvr' : view_opt r' = view_opt r \ {c :: rest}) :
    wfo (prune v b l m r') ∧
      view_opt (prune v b l m r') = view_opt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) \ {c :: rest} := by
  have hkl : (c :: rest) ∉ view_opt l := by
    intro hmem
    have h2 := hlo (c :: rest) hmem c rest rfl
    omega
  have hkm : (c :: rest) ∉ (view_opt m).image (fun s => v :: s) := by
    intro hmem
    obtain ⟨t, _, ht⟩ := mem_image_cons hmem
    injection ht with h1 h2
    omega
  have hkE : (c :: rest) ∉ (if b = true then ({[v]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅) := by
    intro hmem
    have hx := mem_end_set hmem
    injection hx with h1 h2
    omega
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases prune_spec v b l m r' with hp | ⟨hp, hpne⟩
    · rw [hp]; trivial
    · rw [hp]
      refine ⟨?_, hpne⟩
      refine wf_mk v b l m r' hv hwl hlo hwr' ?_ hwm
      intro s hs c0 t0 hst
      rw [hvr'] at hs
      exact hro s hs.1 c0 t0 hst
  · rw [view_prune]
    simp only [view_opt_some, view_eq, hvr']
    rw [union_diff_of_not_mem _ _ hkl, diff_union_of_not_mem _ _ hkm,
      diff_union_of_not_mem _ _ hkE]

theorem del_end_case (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (hv : 0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256) (hwl : wfo l) (hwm : wfo m) (hwr : wfo r)
    (hlo : ∀ s ∈ view_opt l, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → c0 < v)
    (hro : ∀ s ∈ view_opt r, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → v < c0) :
    wfo (prune v false l m r) ∧
      view_opt (prune v false l m r) = view_opt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) \ {[v]} := by
  have hkl : [v] ∉ view_opt l := by
    intro hmem
    have h2 := hlo [v] hmem v [] rfl
    omega
  have hkr : [v] ∉ view_opt r := by
    intro hmem
    have h2 := hro [v] hmem v [] rfl
    omega
  have hkm : [v] ∉ (view_opt m).image (fun s => v :: s) := by
    intro hmem
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hteq⟩ := mem_image_cons hmem
    injection hteq with h1 h2
    have h3 : ([] : List Int) ∈ view_opt m := by rw [h2]; exact ht
    exact view_nil_notmem m h3
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases prune_spec v false l m r with hp | ⟨hp, hpne⟩
    · rw [hp]; trivial
    · rw [hp]
      exact ⟨wf_mk v false l m r hv hwl hlo hwr hro hwm, hpne⟩
  · have hL := view_eq v false l m r
    have hR := view_eq v b l m r
    rw [view_prune, hL, view_opt_some, hR]
    have hkX : [v] ∉ view_opt l ∪ view_opt r ∪ ((view_opt m).image (fun s => v :: s)) := by
      simp only [Set.mem_union, not_or]
      exact ⟨⟨hkl, hkr⟩, hkm⟩
    exact end_view_eq v b _ hkX

theorem del_mid_case (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r m' : Option Node)
    (c2 : Int) (rest2 : List Int)
    (hv : 0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256) (hwl : wfo l) (hwm : wfo m) (hwr : wfo r)
    (hlo : ∀ s ∈ view_opt l, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → c0 < v)
    (hro : ∀ s ∈ view_opt r, ∀ (c0 : Int) (t0 : List Int), s = c0 :: t0 → v < c0)
    (hwm' : wfo m') (hvm' : view_opt m' = view_opt m \ {c2 :: rest2}) :
    wfo (prune v b l m' r) ∧
      view_opt (prune v b l m' r)
        = view_opt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) \ {v :: c2 :: rest2} := by
